evidence.detail: Only {{#played_competitively}}{{> stats}}{{/played_competitively}} — no message or banner when card is illegal in the selected season
legal_seasons is computed and available in the view, but not surfaced in the template as an 'off-track' indicator
The deck table section ('Decks containing …') is always rendered even when there are zero decks because the card is illegal; issue asks to suppress or explain this

triage.notes: Needs UX decisions: what message/banner to display, how prominently to show it, and whether to conditionally suppress the deck table vs show an empty-state explanation. More than a simple template edit.
